# SPEC-NNN Implementation Plan

> Replace every placeholder before publication. This plan derives work from an
> approved Specification and cannot change its contract.

## Authority and Scope

Link the approved Specification, accepted ADRs needed for implementation, and
the MVP reference-application or stack-validation requirement.

## Current Repository State

Summarize relevant modules, source, tests, reusable code, and known gaps.

## Acceptance-Criterion Matrix

| Criterion | Implementation tasks | Evidence | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AC-1` or exact criterion text | Task IDs | Test, build, inspection, or measurement | pending |

Every Specification acceptance criterion must appear exactly once with a
checkable disposition.

## Milestones and Tasks

### Milestone 1: Name

**Entry conditions:** Prerequisites that must already hold.

**Exit evidence:** Observable evidence that completes the milestone.

- [ ] `T1.1` — Task with affected modules/files, dependencies, and required
      tests or evidence.

## Design-Note Triggers

Identify mechanisms expected to need focused Implementation Design Notes and
why. Do not require notes for self-explanatory work.

## Integration and Validation Order

Describe unit, conformance, integration, cross-profile, platform, and hardware
ordering. Keep hardware-free and connected-hardware claims separate.

## Risks and Upstream Blockers

List implementation risks separately from architectural or contractual issues
that must return upstream before affected work proceeds.

## Deferred and Follow-up Work

Link optional discoveries captured through Future Work, Exploration, or Spike
records. Do not schedule them as authorized implementation work.

## Completion Record

Record completed, changed, removed, and blocked task dispositions and link the
conformance report. Plan completion does not mark the Specification
implemented.
